comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body:
It's still better to try to make it on your own as it counts to the MA for getting Forbidden Alchemy Book. And even if you dont do Nanban, the book can fetch up to 7-8 bil, maybe more depending on demand (and remember, as BonnyLass pointed out, you need Adept title to equip the biretta, which means getting a base rank of R13 in Alchemy).

What also helps for getting the hat is, when the Holy Roman Empire elections come around and if the time period is the 16th century phase 5 or the 17th century phase 1 and Rudolf II wins, one of his benefits is increased success in Alchemy experiments.
